record.field: Website Industry - Enable/disable views and set up menus

website = env.ref('sports_club.website_industry')
to_deactivate = [ # Presets 'website.template_header_default', 'website.header_search_box', 'website.header_text_element', 'website_sale.products_shop_title', 'website_sale.search', 'website_sale.sort', # Default static pages 'website.homepage', 'website.contactus', ] to_activate = [ # Presets 'website.template_header_boxed', 'website.footer_custom', 'website.footer_no_copyright', 'website.header_call_to_action', 'website_sale.filmstrip_categories_pills', ]
ctx = {'website_id': website.id}
for xml_id in to_deactivate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': False}) for xml_id in to_activate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': True})
menus = env['website.menu'] base_domain = [('website_id', '=', website.id)] top_menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('parent_id', '=', False)], limit=1)
# Default menu items this site does not use (the logo already links home) menus.search(base_domain + [('url', 'in', ['/', '/appointment', '/shop'])]).unlink() # The only four entries, in the order the footer navigation lists them for name, url, sequence in [ ('Our club', '/our-club', 10), ('Products', '/products', 20), ('Coaches', '/coaches', 30), ('Join us', '/contactus', 40), ]: menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', url)], limit=1) if menu: menu.write({'name': name, 'sequence': sequence}) else: menus.create({ 'name': name, 'url': url, 'sequence': sequence, 'website_id': website.id, 'parent_id': top_menu.id, })
MARK = '__EXPORT_FILTER_XMLID__' for view in env['ir.ui.view'].sudo().search([('website_id', '=', website.id)]): arch = view.arch_db or '' if MARK not in arch: continue new_arch = arch while MARK in new_arch: start = new_arch.index(MARK) end = new_arch.index(MARK, start + len(MARK)) + len(MARK) xmlid = new_arch[start + len(MARK):end - len(MARK)] try: resolved = str(env.ref(xmlid).id) except ValueError: resolved = '0' new_arch = new_arch[:start] + resolved + new_arch[end:] view.write({'arch_db': new_arch})
# The booking link carries database ids (appointment type id + invite token), # so the views ship with a *court_booking* token that we swap here for the # real url, once every view using it has been loaded. BOOKING_TOKEN = '*court_booking*' booking_url = env.ref('sports_club.appointment_invite_sport_court').redirect_url.replace('&', '&') for view in env['ir.ui.view'].sudo().search([('website_id', '=', website.id)]): arch = view.arch_db or '' if BOOKING_TOKEN in arch: view.write({'arch_db': arch.replace(BOOKING_TOKEN, booking_url)})
